verdicts.reason: A: a stray rule floats at the very top above a large dead zone around 'J'adore Paris', which sits far from the rest of its brand lockup. 'LAVANDER' sits across the white label's top edge, breaking the frame, and the illustrations are scattered and almost touching (the bottles and jar are crowded and the soap bar floats loose). B: 'J'adore Paris' and the label sit together at the top, so it reads in better order, but 'LAVANDER' still collides with the label frame. There is also a large empty gap in the middle, and the illustration pieces are spread apart as loose fragments instead of the original's still-life group, so B is only slightly better.
